title: 第515章 戏精登场第514章 道爷的火气有点大
content_zh:
下午，参加完“挤神仙”活动的许仙，小心翼翼地捂着自己的布袋，狗狗祟祟地回到了保安堂的后院。
他的脸上，带着几分紧张，几分期待，还有几分......害怕。
布袋里，装着他早上刚从王道灵手里买来的三张灵符。
三十两银子！
那可是白娘子给他，让他买东西回来讨她欢心的！
但王道灵说了，这三张灵符，乃是玄坛老祖亲赐，能除邪祟、降妖魔、保家宅、保平安！
只要烧了，就能除掉家里的“脏东西”！
想着想着，许仙情不自禁地想起了昨晚，自己在桥边看见的那张鬼脸......
惨白如纸，满头白发，一具骷髅在白发下一闪一闪的......
“嘶～”
他情不自禁地打了个哆嗦，身体如筛糠般颤抖。
来不及去见娘子了，一到后院，他就立即走到了池塘旁的小桥上。
这里，正是昨晚见鬼的地方。
许仙站在桥上，扭头四顾，目光在假山、池塘、柳树之间来回扫视。
害怕那个鬼，再次出现。
片刻之后，见后院没人，许仙连忙把手伸进布袋，在布袋里摸索片刻，掏出了那三张灵符。
灵符通体金黄，以朱砂书写着繁复的符文，散发着淡淡的威压。
许仙的脑海里，回想起王道灵嘱咐的使用方法：
“许公子，这三道灵符，需在无人之处，以火点燃。”
“灵符点燃之后，会化作金光，直冲天际。”

“届时，玄坛老祖便会感知，降下天罚，除尽邪祟！”
许仙深吸一口气，从怀中掏出一个火折子。
“咔嚓～”
火折子点燃，火苗摇曳。
他的手，在发抖。
小小的火苗，在微风中晃动，映得他的脸，忽明忽暗。
“呼～”
许仙吹了口气，将火苗吹旺。
然后，他将一张灵符，凑近火苗。
“唰～”
灵符一遇到火星，瞬间燃烧！
火焰并非寻常的橙红色，而是纯粹的金色！
那金色火焰，如一轮小太阳，在许仙手中绽放！
“轰～”
灵符霎那间燃烧殆尽，化作一道耀眼的金光，冲天而起！
那金光，璀璨夺目，如一根金色的天柱，直插云霄！
原本阳光明媚的天空，顷刻间暗了下来！
“咔嚓～”
层层叠叠的乌云，从四面八方汇聚而来，如墨海翻涌！
转眼间，便将整个苏杭城笼罩其中！

“轰隆隆～”
一道道雷霆，在乌云中穿梭、游走，如一条条紫色的巨龙，发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣声！
content_en:
In the afternoon, after participating in the "Squeeze the Gods" activity, Xu Xian carefully covered his bag and the dog returned to the backyard of the security hall.
There was a bit of nervousness, a bit of anticipation, and a bit of... fear on his face.
In the cloth bag were three talismans that he had just bought from Wang Daoling in the morning.
Thirty taels of silver!
That was given to him by White Snake, asking him to buy things to please her!
But Wang Daoling said that these three spiritual talismans were given by the ancestor of Xuantan. They can ward off evil spirits, subdue demons, protect the home, and ensure peace!
As long as you burn it, you can get rid of the "dirty things" in your home!
Thinking about it, Xu Xian couldn't help but think of the grimace he saw by the bridge last night...
Pale as paper, with a head full of white hair, a skeleton flashing under the white hair...
"Hiss~"
He couldn't help but shiver, his body shaking like chaff.
It was too late to see his wife. As soon as he arrived in the backyard, he immediately walked to the small bridge next to the pond.
This is where the ghost happened last night.
Xu Xian stood on the bridge, turned around and glanced back and forth between the rockery, the pond, and the willow trees.
Afraid of that ghost appearing again.
After a while, seeing no one in the backyard, Xu Xian quickly put his hand into the bag, groped in the bag for a while, and took out the three talismans.
The spirit talisman is golden in color, with complex runes written in cinnabar, exuding a touch of coercion.
In Xu Xian's mind, he recalled the instructions given by Wang Daoling:
"Mr. Xu, these three spiritual talismans need to be lit with fire in a place where there is no one around."
"After the talisman is lit, it will turn into golden light and shoot straight into the sky."
"At that time, the ancestor of Xuantan will sense it and send down the heavenly punishment to eliminate all evil spirits!"
Xu Xian took a deep breath and took out a fire seal from his arms.
"Click~"
The fire was lit and the flames flickered.
His hands were shaking.
The small flames swayed in the breeze, making his face flicker.
"Hoo~"
Xu Xian blew a breath to inflate the flames.
Then, he brought a magic talisman close to the flames.
"Shua~"
As soon as the talisman encounters sparks, it burns instantly!
The flame is not the usual orange-red color, but pure gold!
The golden flame, like a small sun, bloomed in Xu Xian's hands!
"Boom~"
The spiritual talisman burned out in an instant and turned into a dazzling golden light, rising into the sky!
That golden light was so dazzling that it shot straight into the sky like a golden pillar!
The originally sunny sky suddenly darkened!
"Click~"
Layers of dark clouds gathered from all directions, like a sea of ink surging!
In the blink of an eye, the entire city of Suzhou and Hangzhou was enveloped!
"Boom~"
Streams of thunder shuttled and swam through the dark clouds, like huge purple dragons, making a deafening roar!
